title: 弃马分麦、并肩奔逃

The adjacent segments are the same continuous escape event, so the music stays in the chase register. | Review: Line 2573 shows swinging torchlight and a shout of "找到了！" from deeper in the tunnel; line 2574 has Lawrence seize Holo's hand and sprint back along the path while the spotted pursuers break into a run — unmistakable active pursuit, not lurking suspense. Lines 2577–2581 then turn inward: Lawrence's mental map fails ("脑袋变成一片空白的错觉") as the maze overwhelms him, so the score must keep kinetic chase momentum while layering disorientation. Continuity confirms the classification: the prior block maintains "急促的追逐乐音" and the next block shifts to a cornered-beast dead-end theme — all one unbroken escape event, making "chase" the right texture over scheming/creeping_dread.
bgm_music_prompt: A breathless medieval-fantasy chase underscore in a restless minor mode, written to sit under urgent whispered dialogue. Sparse nervous woodwind flurries — piccolo and oboe darting in uneven, spiraling figures — over a taut bed of overlapping staccato strings and a low relentless cello ostinato that pulses beneath the voices. Muffled frame-drum taps quicken the heartbeat, while a lone viola holds an uneasy tremolo as the tunnel twists into labyrinthine uncertainty. The arc begins in controlled urgency, then woodwinds climb into panic-stricken cascades and strings compress into a suffocating, circling texture as disorientation peaks, before pulling back just enough to let the next decision land.

title: 撞上死路的抉择
description: T字路口右转却迎头撞上死路，罗伦斯踢墙泄愤，凭回声判断追兵众多，只能决定回头，赫萝却已喘得只能点头回应。音乐转为焦躁的困兽主题，短促鼓点与压抑低音渲染无路可退的窘迫。
bgm_evidence: Primary: 「又是死路。」——T字路口右转后迎头撞上死路，罗伦斯「不由地踢了墙壁一下」；凭「回响在地下道里的怒吼声及脚步声」判断「他们派出相当多手下」，耳边脚步联想成「大群蚂蚁般的追捕者」。赫萝已「喘得只能动动头部来回答」。这里没有直接打斗，核心是走投无路、追兵逼近的焦虑与悬而未决的紧张，属悬疑压迫而非战斗，故归 suspense / creeping_dread。 | Review: 场景核心不是打斗：罗伦斯在T字路口「不由地踢了墙壁一下」，赫萝「加重握住罗伦斯手的力道」——肢体语言表达的是焦虑而非战斗；威胁来自看不见的追兵，只能靠「回响在地下道里的怒吼声及脚步声」判断人数，耳朵里把脚步幻听成「大群蚂蚁般的追捕者」。随后转为决策（「还是先回头」）与体力告急（赫萝「只能动动头部来回答」）。全程无正面冲突，本质是走投无路、被逼近但尚未交手的悬而未决，属 suspense 而非 battle/chase；虽有疲态，但主导情绪是困兽般的压迫感而非悲伤，故不以 continuity 沿用前段的 sad。场景无标定观察、密谋或揭密，最贴合 creeping_dread。

Low piano octaves and a dark bassoon rest on a slow, knotted ostinato while sparse cello pizzicato and a bowed cymbal shimmer trace the shadow of unseen footsteps. A contrabass clarinet threads a circling phrase that tightens on each repetition, rising in small anxious increments as a soft heartbeat pulse grows subtly insistent; then the music thins as resolve settles into weary quiet, leaving a low drone and one distant metallic toll. Sparse and intimate, paced to sit beneath exhausted, whispered dialogue without ever erupting.

Around them, a barely-there string drone and distant harp harmonics stretch the silence, dynamics kept intimate and restrained, every phrase holding its breath. title: 呼唤与扶持

description: 罗伦斯发现左臂已被赫萝撕下袖子包扎妥当，赫萝改走在前方领路，后方的脚步声却仍紧追不舍。音乐转为压抑而坚定的行进节奏，紧迫感与重燃的求生意志并肩推进。

This reads as hidden danger + mounting tension (suspense/creeping_dread), not battle/chase; it also sits naturally between the previous warm daily/indoor_talk pause and the next bright sprint segment, building suppressed urgency without jumping to full chase energy.

title: 绝境中的对峙
description: 枯井绝路之下，脚步声步步逼近，梅迪欧商行手下终于现身。罗伦斯以残存之力拔出短剑挡在赫萝身前，双脚却如生根般动弹不得。音乐以压抑的弦乐与低音鼓点铺陈，营造被逼至绝路的窒息感与一触即发的杀机。

bgm_music_prompt: Brooding chamber suspense score: low cello and viola drones over a slow, muffled timpani heartbeat, the air suffocating as if trapped at the bottom of a deep stone well. A hesitant bass clarinet thread circles without resolving; muted contrabass and a distant, trembling double-bass pulse creep forward in measured, dragging steps. bgm_avoid: No vocals, lyrics, or spoken words; no sound effects or foley; no bright brass fanfares or major-key warmth; no fast combat drumming; no trailer impact hits or bombastic swells.

title: 背叛者的现身

He then turns his gaze to Holo and coolly voices the suspicion that she matches "长久住在村子的麦田里，能够自在操控丰收与否的狼之化身" (2712), and Holo flinches while Lawrence does not look back (2713). Yelle steps out with "身上带着大地与太阳的色彩" yet "露出些许悲伤的表情" (2703) — the sorrow is a mask over calculation, and his fine clothing immediately exposes "他与梅迪欧商行的关系有多深" (2706), confirming he is an agent working against the travelers. His dialogue is strategic probing, not confession: "懂得这笔交易的村民很少" (2705) deflects, then he coolly pivots to Holo, voicing the exact suspicion of "狼之化身" (2712) while Holo flinches and Lawrence refuses to look back (2713) — a chess move delivered in friendly tones.
